patch_description: Diversify initialization away from the 0.24 basin with several structured candidates (icosahedron + poles at varied heights and axes, Fibonacci-sphere spiral, cuboctahedron + poles, antiprism-like, and random sphere starts). For each start, run SLSQP maximizing the minimum squared distance t subject to all squared pairwise distances ≥ t and ≤ 1 (fixing the diameter to 1, which makes the min/max ratio directly = sqrt(t)). Track the best true ratio across all starts and return the normalized winner. This constrained formulation directly optimizes the exact objective instead of a softmin surrogate, and the varied structured starts escape the icosahedron+poles basin.
